description: This file defines the BidiChromium class, which extends BrowserType, and manages the connection and configuration of Chromium browsers with bidirectional protocol support in the Playwright project. It includes methods for connecting transports, handling startup errors, and generating default launch arguments.

classes.name: BidiChromium
classes.description: A class extending BrowserType that manages Chromium browser instances with bidirectional protocol support, including connection handling, error rewriting, environment amendments, and default argument generation.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the browser transport, wrapping it with bidiOverCdp, and returns a BidiBrowser instance.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup error logs to provide more user-friendly messages, especially for sandboxing issues.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the environment variables, potentially amended for the browser process.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a close message to the browser via the transport, reusing the bidiTransport if available.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported; returns false.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chromium based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, returning the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: _innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Constructs the core set of command-line arguments for Chromium, adding options based on launch parameters.
